sources.title: G4.5 Brush + Arc Architecture v0.2 - VectorStroke First
G4.5-10 Gate Amendment v0.2 - Vector Freehand + Windows Arc Parity
G4.5 VectorStroke + Arc Implementation Plan v0.2

trusted_statements: G4.5 implements VectorStroke only; Dab/Texture/Natural Media are design-only.
Axiom is the single brush semantic owner; Arc consumes render-ready vector preview geometry and never runs a second freehand algorithm.
RB-V01 start/end taper remains visible but is frozen by immutable brush family/version semantics for G4.5 V1 qualification.
G4.5 live controls are size, pressure/thinning, and smoothing/streamline.
No canonical ObjectKind, Operation, StrokeRecord, or BrushDescriptor schema expansion is authorized by 09V.
Axiom canonical uses Skia; Windows Arc reference preview uses an independently owned Skia-capable preview path.
Space diagnostic is presentation-only and must not alter semantic identity, geometry digest, or canonical data.
RB-V01 must be a real continuous variable-width filled vector stroke, not a fixed-width drawLine approximation.
Same confirmed input and same program version must produce deterministic stable geometry.
Chunked incremental evaluation and one-shot evaluation must converge within frozen tolerance.
Windows Arc must consume Axiom-produced vector geometry; no Arc-owned width/smoothing/taper algorithm is permitted.
Physical handoff must show Arc-active -> overlap -> canonical-only without material path, width, or taper pop.
DAB/Texture implementation is not required for G4.5 PASS.
GT-G4-5-09V supersedes the old 09F execution path for current G4.5 work.
Trusted base is codex/g4-5-programmable-brush at the reconciled anchor.
The superseded 09F branch must not be used as execution base.
P32 must preserve existing V1 brush behavior and G4/G4.4/G4.5 regressions.

resolved_semantic_decision.rb_v01_identity: BrushFamily::kPen + brush/definition version 2 (or an equivalently explicit immutable version binding without canonical schema expansion)
resolved_semantic_decision.taper: fixed/versioned interpreter semantics; not a G4.5 per-stroke live parameter
resolved_semantic_decision.future_editable_taper: requires later BrushDescriptor/semantic schema review before persistence

preserved_authority: Existing published BrushDefinition/BrushProgram v1 identities and behavior remain compatible.
Existing canonical StrokeRecord alternatives remain unchanged.
G4.4 input arbitration and handoff semantics remain unchanged.
DAB/Texture code on the superseded 09F branch is not inherited into 09V.
